newsitem.title: ITALY: PARMALAT UPGRADED TO BUY BY SALOMON.
newsitem.headline: PARMALAT UPGRADED TO BUY BY SALOMON.

text.p: Italy's largest listed food company Parmalat was upgraded by U.S. investment bank Salomon Brothers to a "buy" recommendation from a previous "hold" with a target price set at 3,135 lire.
Parmalat closed 1.17 percent higher on Tuesday at 2,591 lire.
Salomon Brothers said in a research note that Parmalat shares were cheap relative to its peers and the Italian market.
It added that the market had been overly negative on Parmalat's two recent acquisitions in Canada.

Salomon said that in its view the company paid a low price, and the consequent synergies together with the strong operating environment led the investment bank to project earnings growth averaging 20 percent for 1997-1999.
